serverInfo.name: jlmx.dev portfolio
serverInfo.description: Personal portfolio and blog for a software developer specializing in AI/ML and full-stack development.

transport.description: Tools are provided in-page through navigator.modelContext (WebMCP) when a browsing agent loads this site. There is no remote MCP endpoint; the resources below are plain HTTPS GETs that need no MCP client.

tools.name: get_portfolio_page
tools.description: Fetch any page of this portfolio as Markdown. Supported paths: /, /blog, /blog/{slug}, /projects, /uses.

tools.name: check_site_health
tools.description: Check the operational status of jlmx.dev and its CMS connection.

resources.name: Portfolio homepage
resources.description: Bio, featured projects, and recent blog posts. Request with Accept: text/markdown for agent-friendly format.

resources.name: Blog index
resources.description: All published blog posts. Supports Accept: text/markdown.

resources.name: Projects
resources.description: Full project portfolio. Supports Accept: text/markdown.
